changes.title: Balance reports
items: Balance reports compare bots with the same bags, seeds and record speeds, without changing the game's difficulty.

changes.title: Magic mock
items: An optional magic mock shows fire at three strengths and frost that briefly freezes a tree.

changes.title: Dj booth
items: Her decks are now a DJ booth: choose a record (100 to 200 BPM; you start with 100 and 120, find the rest in the forest), then Get this party started
The whole night plays at the record's tempo
The record shelf on the Terrace is gone
